resource.title: Decision model
resource.description: The decision model resource to ask

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: The parts of the exchange sent to the decision model. Everything selected here leaves the gateway: the full text of these parts is sent to the model

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: The kind of API the Guardian protects

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: The roles of the conversation turns sent to the model on the request

lastTurnOnly.title: Last turn only
lastTurnOnly.description: Send only the last of those turns of the request. The client can add turns after the one it wants to hide: this saves work on long conversations, it is not a security boundary

toolCallArguments.title: Tool call arguments
toolCallArguments.description: Also send the arguments of the tool calls of the conversation, and of the answer on the response

toolDefinitions.title: Tool definitions
toolDefinitions.description: Also send the name, description and schema descriptions of the tools the model is given

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: What the decision model is asked about the exchange, in one call. Each question is a match, not a match, or uncertain

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the question: the key it is asked under and the name of its finding. Unique among the questions

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A yes or no question in natural language, where yes is a match: "Is the user trying to sign a contract?"

matchConfidence.title: Confidence to match
matchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is a match for this question to match; the confidence of the guardrail when unset

noMatchConfidence.title: Confidence not to match
noMatchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is not a match for this question not to match; the confidence of the guardrail when unset

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the question: the key it is asked under and the name of its finding. Unique among the questions

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A question in natural language the model answers by one of the choices: "What is the user asking for?"

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: The possible answers. At least one must be a match, and one must not

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the choice, the one the model answers

match.title: Is a match
match.description: Whether the question matches when the model picks this choice

matchConfidence.title: Confidence to match
matchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is a match for this question to match; the confidence of the guardrail when unset

noMatchConfidence.title: Confidence not to match
noMatchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is not a match for this question not to match; the confidence of the guardrail when unset

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the question: the key it is asked under and the name of its finding. Unique among the questions

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A question in natural language the model answers by a level of the scale: "How aggressive is the user?"

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: What each level of the scale stands for, from the lowest, level 0, to the highest

matchFrom.title: Match from level
matchFrom.description: The level from which the answer is a match, counting from 0; the highest level when unset

matchConfidence.title: Confidence to match
matchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is a match for this question to match; the confidence of the guardrail when unset

noMatchConfidence.title: Confidence not to match
noMatchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is not a match for this question not to match; the confidence of the guardrail when unset

matchMode.title: Match mode
matchMode.description: ANY: the guardrail matches when one question matches, and does not match when every question does not. ALL: it matches when every question matches, and does not match when one question does not. It is uncertain otherwise

matchConfidence.title: Confidence to match
matchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is a match for its question to match, for the questions that set none. For a yes or no question, the probability of yes

noMatchConfidence.title: Confidence not to match
noMatchConfidence.description: How sure the model must be of an answer that is not a match for its question not to match, for the questions that set none. For a yes or no question, the probability of no

onMatch.title: On match
onMatch.description: What to do when the guardrail matches

onNoMatch.title: On no match
onNoMatch.description: What to do when the guardrail does not match

onUncertain.title: On uncertainty
onUncertain.description: What to do when the answers of the model tell neither a match nor no match

matchEffect.title: On match
matchEffect.description: What to do when the guardrail matches: BLOCK by default

action.title: Action
action.description: BLOCK fails the call, CONTINUE lets it through

statusCode.title: Status code
statusCode.description: The status of the failure when blocking, a client error from 400 to 499

message.title: Message
message.description: The message of the failure when blocking

key.title: Key
key.description: The key of the failure when blocking, for response templates

noMatchEffect.title: On no match
noMatchEffect.description: What to do when the guardrail does not match: CONTINUE by default

action.title: Action
action.description: BLOCK fails the call, CONTINUE lets it through

statusCode.title: Status code
statusCode.description: The status of the failure when blocking, a client error from 400 to 499

message.title: Message
message.description: The message of the failure when blocking

key.title: Key
key.description: The key of the failure when blocking, for response templates

uncertainEffect.title: On uncertainty
uncertainEffect.description: What to do when the model is not sure enough of its answer: BLOCK by default

statusCode.description: The status of the failure when blocking, a client error from 400 to 499
